title: phrasings@1: English that carries a meaning only next to others
description: meaning/phrasings.jsonl. Every line after the header lets English carry meaning m in a sentence that also has one of the with meanings: "take" carries go next to bus. With optional instead of en, English may leave m out in such a sentence.

m.description: The meaning (meaning@1 id) the phrasing carries.

with.description: The phrasing applies in a sentence that has any of these meanings.

optional.description: English may leave m out there.
